title: LA Colossal – Ru-Guan 04 (Seated)
prompt:
Fine art body painting photography. Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Chinese woman in her early 50s, silver-streaked black bob, natural face with gentle smile lines.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly resting in multiple deep overlapping rolls over the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips filling the armchair, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body Guan ware celadon body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface. The body painting is the only covering on the body — no garments, no fabric, no robes, no bodysuit, no leggings, no stockings. High-gloss deep pale grey-green glaze clearly different from skin, with a fine dense crackle of thin dark lines, no painted motifs, not kintsugi. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully glazed and crackled.

Pose: Seated in a rosewood armchair, torso turned open toward the camera, one forearm on the armrest, the other hand on her thigh, legs crossed at the knee. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Towering 9-inch grey-green crackle-glazed peep-toe platform stilettos with a single ankle strap.
Nails: Extra long almond nails, pale celadon.

Background & Lighting: Hangzhou garden pavilion with a misty lake, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Soft diffused daylight with warm raking side light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
